title: Living Wiki + Graph phase 2: managed Reference block, deterministic refresh, and verify

AC1.note: refresh.test.ts 'rewrites the block on an accepted page, changing nothing outside it' — prose and the following section compared byte-for-byte

AC2.note: refreshPages imports no provider and takes none; refresh.test.ts completes a full refresh with no model configuration present

AC3.note: refresh.test.ts 'a hand-edited block is refused, and --force overwrites it' — file byte-identical after the refusal

AC4.note: managed-block.test.ts 'running it twice is a no-op' + refresh.test.ts idempotence; duplicated Reference heading refused; no section is never created

AC5.note: Real corpus: 40 migrated, 10 skipped, 0 malformed. Diff = 80 added lines across 40 files, ALL markers, zero removed lines, zero non-marker additions

AC6.note: refresh.test.ts 'stamps provenance and changes nothing else' — every non-provenance line identical

AC7.note: Real corpus end-to-end: before stamping 0 fresh / 44 affected; after wiki verify 44 fresh / 0 affected; after committing real src/wiki changes exactly 4 pages went stale with correct reasons and '1 commits behind'

AC8.note: refresh.test.ts 'bumps only the patch and appends exactly one changelog line' — Version 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1, two changelog lines total

AC9.note: refresh.test.ts 'an already-current page is not rewritten at all' — second refresh leaves the file byte-identical

AC10.note: validate-structure.test.ts: truncated block, unknown marker version, hand-edited block, missing Describes target, non-monotonic changelog. wiki validate passes clean on the migrated corpus

AC11.note: managed-block.test.ts 'an unknown marker version is refused, not guessed at'

AC12.note: Full suite 6758 pass / 48 fail — the same 48 that fail at the branch base

tasks.dispositionReason: Self-review found an overclaim: wiki verify with no arguments stamped all 44 pages, silently asserting a human had reviewed each. Now requires --page (a real review) or --baseline (a measurement starting line, labelled as such in the output)

tasks.title: Managed-block parse/serialise with version and content hash (AC1,AC3,AC11)
tasks.dispositionReason: managed-block.ts: find/wrap/replace with marker version and content hash; malformed shapes reported not thrown; a block with no recorded hash is not treated as tampered. 14 tests (AC1,AC3,AC4,AC11)

tasks.title: wiki migrate-markers: idempotent, never invents a section, refuses duplicates (AC4,AC5)
tasks.dispositionReason: migrateMarkers: idempotent, never authors a section, damage reported. Real corpus: 40 migrated, 10 skipped, 0 malformed; diff is 80 added lines all markers, zero removed (AC4,AC5)

tasks.title: Reference rendering reused from the existing collect renderer, not rewritten (AC1)
tasks.dispositionReason: Reference content comes from collectGraphWikiCandidates (exported from service.ts), the same renderer wiki collect uses — no extraction, no second implementation (AC1)

tasks.title: wiki refresh: deterministic, patch bump, one Changelog line, no-op when current (AC2,AC8,AC9)
tasks.dispositionReason: refreshPages: deterministic, patch-only bump, one changelog line, no-op when current, conflict on hand-edited block with --force override (AC1,AC2,AC3,AC8,AC9)

tasks.title: wiki verify: stamps provenance only, changes nothing else (AC6)
tasks.dispositionReason: verifyPages + wiki verify: stamps VerifiedAt/VerifiedScope only, skips empty describe-sets. Real corpus: 44 stamped, freshness went 0 fresh -> 44 fresh (AC6,AC7)

tasks.title: wiki validate extension: markers, describes targets, monotonic changelog (AC10)
tasks.dispositionReason: wikiValidate extended with managed-block, describes-target and changelog-ordering rules; passes on the migrated corpus. 9 tests (AC10)

tasks.title: End-to-end on this corpus: migrate, verify, freshness turns unknown into fresh (AC7,AC12)
tasks.dispositionReason: End-to-end on the real corpus: migrate -> verify -> 44 fresh; then a real commit to src/wiki turned exactly 4 pages stale with correct reasons and commit counts (AC7,AC12)
